description: This file provides service functions for managing notifications within a gym management backend API. It includes functions for listing notifications by user, marking notifications as read, creating new notifications, and materializing scheduled reminders into notifications, interacting with a SQLAlchemy ORM setup.

methods.name: datetime _utcnow()
methods.description: Utility function to get the current UTC datetime.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Notification],int] list_for_user(db: Session, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications for a specified user, optionally filtering for unread notifications.

methods.name: Optional[Notification] mark_read(db: Session, notif_id: int, user_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read for the given user if authorized.

methods.name: Notification create_notification(db: Session, payload: NotificationCreate, mark_sent_if_past: bool = True)
methods.description: Creates a new notification record, setting sent_at if scheduled_at is in the past or now.

methods.name: int materialize_due_reminders(db: Session, now: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Marks scheduled notifications due (scheduled_at <= now) and not yet sent as sent, returning the count.

ctags.pattern: /^def create_notification(db: Session, payload: NotificationCreate, mark_sent_if_past: bool = True/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, payload: NotificationCreate, mark_sent_if_past: bool = True)

ctags.signature: (db: Session, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)

ctags.pattern: /^def mark_read(db: Session, notif_id: int, user_id: str) -> Optional[Notification]:$/
